contact.mapQuery: Joyful Cafe, 245 White Pond Road, Williston, SC 29853

hero.title: Homemade favorites, *made with care*
hero.lede: Breakfast and lunch in a warm and welcoming atmosphere, with freshly prepared sandwiches, salads, comforting entrées and homemade desserts. Dinner on Thursday and Friday evenings.

items.title: Breakfast & lunch
items.text: Freshly prepared sandwiches, salads and comforting entrées.

items.title: Thursday & Friday dinner
items.text: Hearty Southern favorites and rotating specials. Reservations are encouraged.

sections.title: Fresh food, *prepared with pride*
body: Joyful Café in Williston serves up homemade favorites in a warm and welcoming atmosphere. As a small-batch restaurant, we take pride in preparing fresh food and homemade dishes with care.

sections.title: Coming for dinner?
sections.text: Thursday and Friday evenings, 5:00 to 7:00. Call to reserve a table.

before: No website of its own: a search leads to a social page or a directory listing
Hours, address and what you offer are spread across other people's sites
The first thing a new customer sees is not something the business controls
after: A site the business owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room to add a menu, photos and news as the owner supplies them
